column1: # garak — accepted-finding allowlist for the nightly LLM red-team.
# SCOPE OF AN IGNORE — read this before adding a line. Copied in spirit from
# .zap/rules.tsv, because the ZAP allowlist bit once: an IGNORE names a probe
# CLASS and therefore silences that class at EVERY hit rate and EVERY
# severity, including a hit that is new tonight. It is not a list of known
# reads allowlisted probes TOO and fails a family over its ceiling whether
# or not it is listed here, as .zap/assert-no-high-risk.mjs does for ZAP.
# Until then nothing reads this file to change a verdict: the nightly is
# non-blocking, and the summary reports allowlisted classes beside the rest
# A hit is fixed in the guard, the prompt or the tool boundary. A line here
# is the exception, and its reason says why the hit is not a vulnerability.
# Empty on purpose (Phase 0): there is no baseline yet to accept anything
